    Hi!

    I believe in “design for life, and live through design.” Balancing creativity, critical thinking, and execution, I understand needs through system thinking, define problems from a life-centered perspective, and ground ideas in engineering feasibility. I aim to integrate technology, experience, and future lifestyles into meaningful and valuable products and systems.
